jd_text:
Senior Backend Engineer (Python) - Orbitpay
Bengaluru / Remote (India)

About the role
Orbitpay is building payments infrastructure for SMBs across South Asia. We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own core services in our payments platform.

What you'll do
- Design, build and operate high-throughput Python microservices for payment processing
- Own REST and gRPC APIs consumed by web, mobile and partner integrations
- Build event-driven workflows on Kafka for settlement and reconciliation
- Improve reliability: observability, alerting and on-call for your services
- Optimize PostgreSQL schemas and queries for scale
- Mentor engineers and lead technical design reviews
- Work with product to break down ambiguous problems into shippable increments

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of backend software engineering experience
- Strong Python (FastAPI or Django)
- Production experience with PostgreSQL and Redis
- Experience with Kafka or another message broker
- Docker and Kubernetes in production
- Experience with AWS
- CI/CD pipelines and automated testing

Nice to have
- Payments or fintech domain experience
- Go
- Terraform
- Prometheus and Grafana
